why: Each row uses each connector once (arc over the top, U-curve under, straight bar), each base once (1, 2 and 3 lines) and each ball pair once (hatched-white, black-hatched, white-black). Row 3 is missing the U-curve, the 2-line base and the hatched-left, white-right pair, which is exactly option 2. Option 1 has the right balls but a straight bar and only 1 base line.
trick: In 3x3 grids, list what each row already has (shape, base lines, shading); the missing cell takes the one item of each kind not yet used.
note: Scan is faint in the options; option 6 left ball looks faded/hatched and the U-curves in options 4 and 5 look broken near the pole, drawn as in the scan.
